blurb:

• Discover the best of the Library of Congress with a 5-Star Private Guide
• Gain seamless access to this popular attraction with pre-booked timed tickets

Embark on a 2-hour private tour of the Library of Congress with Rosotravel, where you’ll experience one of the most awe-inspiring cultural landmarks in the world. Enjoy a tailored journey through this grand library, guided by a Licensed Private Guide who will share captivating stories.
